manage.lead: Reassure; screen facial and limb stains; laser is specialist.

points: Pulsed dye laser via specialist; earlier childhood treatment often preferred.

items.t: Facial V1 stain: ophthalmology (glaucoma) and neurology (Sturge–Weber).
Limb stain with overgrowth or asymmetry.

quiz.a: No; it grows with the child and may darken and thicken.

quiz.q: Which syndrome must be considered with a V1 facial stain?
How is a salmon patch different?
quiz.a: Pale, midline and fades in early childhood.
